sentences.text: 2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. K.S.PADMAVATHAMMA.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused was induced as a tenant in property No.17, situated at Banashankari 3rd stage by the brother of CW1 by name Rajendra Gupta on 02-09-2009.
Later the brother of the CW1 died on 10-06-2013.
Later as the CW1 was the legal heir she had requested the accused to vacate the premises.

Later the accused with an intention to cheat the CW1 had forged and created a GPA alleging the deceased Rajendra Gupta to have executed in his name and by acting as seller and purchaser of the property had registered a sale deed in his name.
Later using the alleged forged documents as genuine has further sold the property to others.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.92/2015 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I.
Channamanakere Acchukattu P.S. has filed chargesheet against  3  C.C.No.4895/2018 accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined 3 witnesses as PW-1 to 3 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex . P1
is the first information statement.

was examined as PW-1 Smt. Padmavathamma.
She in her examination-in-chief has deposed her brother Rajendra Gupta was unmarried and was residing in the property.
He was not healthy and was under treatment at New Den Rehabilitation Centre.
Hence, the property was rented to accused herein.
He used to pay rent.
Other than the rental transaction the accused did not have any monetary transaction with her brother.
He had mortgaged the property to LIC housing finance and used the amount for his treatment.
The mortgage was done through his GPA holder Nagasena Reddy.
Later he had died in the year 2013.
Later when she went to the house she saw the house was demolished and the accused claimed the property was his as Rajendra Gupta had sold it to him.
Later when she inquired she came to know that by acting as GPA of Rajendra Gupta the accused had executed a sale deed in his favour.
The accused had created and forged the GPA and sale deed.
Her brother did not have any transaction with the accused herein.
Later she gave complaint as per Ex.P1.
However the witness never tendered herself for cross examination even after several attempts to secure her.
Hence, later after proclamation and NBW she as dropped.
As the witness has not tendered herself for cross

sentences.text: 11. CW2 N.K.Girish was examined as PW2.
He in his chief examination has deposed that he knows the accused and his father.
He has further deposed that about 10-11 years before the accused came to him and told that he has taken a house and to sign the same.
The said document was in english language and he did not know the contents of the same.
The accused took his signature on the document and went.
Later after 2-3 years the police called him to police station and told that the document was a forged document.
There he came to know about the complaint.
He has identified the document as Ex-P2.
12 . CW8 Jayaram Reddy, ASI is examined as PW3.
He has deposed he arrested the accused and produced him before CW9.
13. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has never turned up for cross examination and her evidence cannot be relied.

Further as the case of the prosecution wholly relies upon  7  C.C.No.4895/2018 the forgery and creation of document, the prosecution had to prove the same by examining the expert who has given the report.

However, the prosecution has failed to examine the expert to prove that the signature on the documents are forged one and the Smt K S Padmavathamma vs Harsha Belavadi on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192819165/
5 document is also a forged document.

sentences.text: The prosecution has also failed to examine the I.O. to show the manner in which the investigation was conducted and from whose custody the alleged forged documents were seized.
In the absence of the above, this court cannot hold the accused as guilty wholly based upon the evidence of PW2.
Hence, this court holds that the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

14. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 419, 420, 471, 468 of IPC .
C.C.No.4895/2018 The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
